coach.name: Frank Martin
coach.notes: Overall record 350-260 and 62-59 at UMass entering 2026-27, 7-11 in MAC play in the program's first MAC season (2025-26), per Wikipedia 2026-27 MAC season page. A Greenfield Recorder headline seen in search says he signed a two-year extension after UMass's first 20-win season in a decade (2024-25; page not read). Says 2026-27 is 'the most complete team to my personality' and the first time he has had seven returning players at UMass. Staff on official site: associate head coach Allen Edwards, assistants Brian Steele and Matt Figger, directors of player development Anthony Evans and Doug Edwards, director of operations Toby Lane. His son Christian Martin is a freshman guard on the roster.

previews.title: 2026-27 MAC Men's Basketball Preview
previews.author: Sam Federman
previews.summary: UMass appears fifth in the article's order (after Kent State, Miami, Toledo, Ohio). Federman says San Francisco transfer Junjie Wang has produced a lot of scoring in exhibitions and could be one of the top scorers in the MAC, with sophomore point guard Danny Carbuccia expected to feed him. Jayden Ndjigue is cited for energy on the wing and the author is 'high' on freshman guard Cam Hailey.

previews.title: UMass men's basketball: Minutemen finalize roster, Hoophall Classic matchup for 2026-27 season
previews.author: Mike Maynard
previews.summary: Roster is set with seven returners, five freshmen and three transfers (Jordan Clayton, Abdullah Ahmed, Junjie Wang). Martin says the newcomers bring 'size, a physicality, a defensive mindset' and that rim protection was a problem: UMass ranked 340th of 365 in blocks per game (2.2) in 2025-26. Graduates Marcus Banks Jr., Daniel Hankins-Sanford and Leonardo Bettiol leave a gap. UMass will play Wake Forest Dec 6, 2026 at the MassMutual Center in Springfield in the Basketball Hall of Fame Classic, the first meeting since 1996-97.

player_claims.claim: 6-10 big from BYU; 1.4 blocks per game in 2025-26 and 2.1 bpg the prior year with the G League's Westchester Knicks.

previews.title: UMass men's basketball: Martin hails 2026-27 roster as 'most complete team' during summer session
previews.author: Adam Hargraves
previews.summary: From an hour-long summer practice at the Champions Center. Martin: 'I don't know if this is going to be the best team I've had, but this is the most complete team to my personality,' promising depth. Danny Carbuccia (MAC All-Freshman, 207 assists, 33 steals) is the stabilizer; Jayden Ndjigue (about 6 ppg last year) is expected to play with more offensive confidence. Northwestern transfer Jordan Clayton, a Medford native who played 69 games with 20 starts and shot 41% from three, was personally recruited by Martin ('Jordan is a winner'). Freshman Christian Martin is the coach's son.

player_claims.claim: MAC All-Freshman team; led team with 207 assists and 33 steals; stabilizer for newcomers.
